source: 合规替代表达.md, cleaned with more conservative financial compliance wording
cleaningPrinciples: Prefer learning, observation, public information, and risk-awareness wording.
Avoid all return implication, deterministic opportunity language, private traffic inducement, and specific asset recommendation.
When the original replacement still implies safety or returns, downgrade it to neutral educational wording.
Every rewritten phrase should be suitable for draft generation but still require final human review.
